_doc: Building interiors (js/interior.js logic, js/interiorfig.js drawing). An interior belongs to building types ('at': world.js door types); walk up to such a building's front door and ENTER. It is built as a room 'pocket' metres above that building (so the minimap, friends and the map still put you there) and you walk it like the island. Local coordinates: metres from the room's centre on the floor, x to the right as you come in, z toward the front door (the front wall is z = d/2), y up. 'door.x' = where the doorway is on the front wall. Props (k): pool (billiard table, playable: SHOOT), counter (w, d), shelf (bottles, back wall), stool, table (round), chair, jukebox, rack (cues on a wall), sign (neon text: text, color, y), board (menu with the shop's prices: shop), plant, fan (ceiling), tv. ry = turn in radians. 'shops': a counter you ORDER at (shop id in data/shop.json, r = reach). 'people': archetype from data/npc.json, pose from js/figure.js POSES, y = lift (sitting), ry (0 faces the back wall, 3.14 faces the door). A new interior is data only: an entry here + a building type in 'at'.
